syn-s1.name: Margaret Ellis
syn-s1.householdNotes: Lives alone. Daughter Sarah phones from overseas at weekends.

syn-s2.name: Arthur Nakamura
syn-s2.householdNotes: Lives alone since his wife died. Son David lives in Osaka.

syn-s3.name: Dorothy Ishii
syn-s3.householdNotes: Lives alone. Speaks slowly and takes her time; this is usual for her.

syn-s4.name: Harold Brooks
syn-s4.householdNotes: Lives alone. Plays golf on Saturdays; daughter Claire lives abroad.

syn-s5.name: Joan Whitfield
syn-s5.householdNotes: Lives alone. Goes to the community centre most weeks.

syn-c1.name: Edith Carter
syn-c1.householdNotes: Lives alone. Son Michael phones from overseas on Sundays.

syn-c2.name: Walter Hughes
syn-c2.householdNotes: Lives alone near the harbour. Daughter Rachel visits twice a year.

syn-c3.name: Irene Okada
syn-c3.householdNotes: Lives alone. Daughter Laura lives in Tokyo and calls most evenings.

syn-c4.name: George Bennett
syn-c4.householdNotes: Lives alone. Keen photographer; son Richard lives abroad.

syn-c5.name: Mary Fujita
syn-c5.householdNotes: Lives alone. Walks by the canal most mornings.
